subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 2: Story – First day at a new school!
outcomes: Understand the main events of the story First day at a new school!
Put the story events in order and retell them.
Explain Bo's problem: magnets attract metal.

tf.s: Lottie feels nervous at the start of the story.
tf.why: Yes! It is her first day, so she is nervous.
Correct! Mrs Safa is the headteacher.

tf.s: The loud noise is in the science lab.
tf.why: The loud noise is in the ICT classroom.
Great! Bo is Sami's ICT robot.

tf.s: A magnet pulls Bo because Bo is made of metal.

tf.why: Paper is not metal, so a magnet does not pull it.

tf.s: The children have Science at quarter past eleven on Mondays and Wednesdays.
tf.why: Well done! That is in the story.

tf.s: The story starts when everyone meets Bo.
tf.why: First, the children arrive at school. Meeting Bo is at the end.

tf.s: They have English at half past eight.
tf.why: Correct! English is at half past eight.

boxes.q: How does Lottie feel at first?
boxes.why: It is her first day, so she feels nervous.
The noise comes from the ICT classroom.
A key is made of metal, so the magnet pulls it.
The story starts when the children arrive.

boxes.q: A kind sentence for a nervous new pupil:
o: Don't worry! I can show you around.
boxes.why: Kind words help a new friend feel happy.

boxes.q: Which word helps us put events in order?
boxes.why: First, then, after that and finally help us order events.

mcq.q: Where is the headteacher's office in the story?
o: It is in the ICT classroom.
mcq.why: Fatma shows Lottie the headteacher's office.

mcq.q: Who does everyone meet at the end of the story?
mcq.why: At the end, everyone meets Bo.

mcq.q: What do the children have at quarter past eleven on Mondays and Wednesdays?
mcq.why: They have Science at quarter past eleven.

mcq.q: Which is the last sequencing word?
mcq.why: We use 'finally' for the last event.

mcq.q: Put in order: (a) Lottie meets the headteacher (b) There's a loud noise (c) Fatma shows Lottie the school
mcq.why: Fatma shows the school, Lottie meets the headteacher, then there is a noise.

mcq.q: You have a magnet. Which object will it pull?
o: a pencil case made of cloth
mcq.why: Magnets attract metal things like keys.

mcq.q: A new pupil looks nervous. What can you say?
mcq.why: Kind words help a new friend at school.

mcq.q: Why does the magnet pull Bo?
mcq.why: Good thinking! Magnets attract metal, and Bo is metal.

o: It is her first day at a new school.
mcq.why: A first day at a new school can make us nervous.

mcq.q: Which sentence tells the end of the story?
o: There's a loud noise and everyone meets Bo.
Fatma shows Lottie the science lab.
mcq.why: The noise and meeting Bo come at the end.
